name: DescribeHistoryEvents

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的记录数，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于 0 且不超过 integer 的最大值，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The status of the event. Valid values:

Archived
UnArchived
All
parameters.help_zh:
事件状态。取值说明：
Archived：已归档
UnArchived：未归档
All：所有
parameters.name: archive_status

parameters.help_en:
The system event category. Valid values:

Exception: abnormal events.
Optimize: optimization events.
Notification: Notification events.
Maintenance: scheduled maintenance events
parameters.help_zh:
系统事件分类。取值说明：
Exception：异常事件
Optimize：优化事件
Notification：通知事件
Maintenance：计划内运维事件
parameters.name: event_category

parameters.help_en:
The system event type. This parameter takes effect only when InstanceEventType.N is not specified. Valid values:

SystemMaintenance.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to system maintenance.
SystemMaintenance.Redeploy: The instance is redeployed due to system maintenance.
SystemFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to a system error.
SystemFailure.Redeploy: The instance is redeployed due to a system error.
SystemFailure.Delete: The instance is released due to an instance creation failure.
InstanceFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to an instance error.
InstanceExpiration.Stop: The subscription instance is stopped due to expiration.
InstanceExpiration.Delete: The subscription instance is released due to expiration.
AccountUnbalanced.Stop: The pay-as-you-go instance is stopped due to an overdue payment.
AccountUnbalanced.Delete: The pay-as-you-go instance is released due to an overdue payment.

For more information about event types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66574.html. The values of this parameter are applicable only to instance system events, but not to disk system events
parameters.help_zh:
系统事件的类型。EventType参数只在未指定InstanceEventType.N参数时有效。取值范围： 

SystemMaintenance.Reboot：因系统维护实例重启。
SystemMaintenance.Redeploy：因系统维护实例重新部署。
SystemFailure.Reboot：因系统错误实例重启。
SystemFailure.Redeploy：因系统错误实例重新部署。
SystemFailure.Delete：因实例创建失败实例释放。
InstanceFailure.Reboot：因实例错误实例重启。
InstanceExpiration.Stop：因包年包月期限到期，实例停止。
InstanceExpiration.Delete：因包年包月期限到期，实例释放。
AccountUnbalanced.Stop：因账号欠费，按量付费实例停止。
AccountUnbalanced.Delete：因账号欠费，按量付费实例释放。

事件类型说明请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66574.html。该参数的取值只能是实例系统事件，不能是磁盘系统事件
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en:
The level of the event. Valid values:

INFO
WARN
CRITICAL
parameters.help_zh:
事件级别，取值说明：
INFO：通知
WARN：警告
CRITICAL：紧急
parameters.name: event_level

parameters.help_en:
The status of the event. Valid values:

Inquiring
Scheduled: Planned
Running
Succeed
Failed
Canceled

Separate multiple states with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
事件状态，取值说明：
Inquiring：问询中
Scheduled：计划中
Running：执行中
Succeed：执行完成
Failed：执行失败
Canceled：已取消
如需查询多个状态，使用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: event_status

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

Instance: instance resources.
Host: host resources.
User: user resources

If you do not specify this parameter, events of all resource types are queried
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值说明：
Instance：实例资源
Host：主机资源
User：用户资源
该参数不填写，表示查询所有类型
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务的最早开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: from_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. Only events that have a start time earlier than or equal to the time specified by this parameter are queried
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务的最晚开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间），需晚于任务的最早开始时间
parameters.name: to_start_time
